context: DOC-C §15.2 UI critical flows required as browser E2E
symptom: Layered startup integration faults: web source resolution, runtime-specific Node imports, DSN query assembly, and bootstrap schema mapping.
root_cause: Layered startup integration faults: web source resolution, runtime-specific Node imports, DSN query assembly, and bootstrap schema mapping.
failed_approach: Rely on static/type tests and generic bundler aliasing without executing the Next server in a real browser gate.
why_failed: Rely on static/type tests and generic bundler aliasing without executing the Next server in a real browser gate.
successful_recovery: Drive fixes from GitHub browser job logs until startup, migration prep, Playwright assertions, and evidence attestation all pass on one SHA.
regression_test: Mandatory UI browser job; runtime-scoped instrumentation; DSN regression tests; mapped-field bootstrap tests.
prevention: Mandatory UI browser job; runtime-scoped instrumentation; DSN regression tests; mapped-field bootstrap tests.
reusable_rule: Do not weaken/skip browser E2E, migration proof, or release-attestation dependencies to obtain green CI.

symptom: UI did not consume canonical session role or CSRF token.
root_cause: UI did not consume canonical session role or CSRF token.
successful_recovery: Gate form on FREEZE+OWNER+CSRF and send x-csrf-token; leave recoverability decision to backend.
reusable_rule: Browser/UI truth must be proven through canonical backend state and real E2E where required.

symptom: UI used noncanonical collection list calls for directives and runs instead of canonical detail-by-ID navigation.
root_cause: UI used noncanonical collection list calls for directives and runs instead of canonical detail-by-ID navigation.
successful_recovery: Remove GET /api/directives and GET /api/runs list calls; navigate through canonical detail-by-ID surfaces.
reusable_rule: Browser/UI truth must be proven through canonical backend state and real E2E where required.

symptom: SystemStateProvider treated absence/failure of backend truth as READY and read data.state instead of top-level SystemEnvelope.state.
root_cause: SystemStateProvider treated absence/failure of backend truth as READY and read data.state instead of top-level SystemEnvelope.state.
failed_approach: Optimistic READY initialization plus silent error handling for a blocking state source.
why_failed: Optimistic READY initialization plus silent error handling for a blocking state source.
successful_recovery: Use nullable canonical state, explicit readiness, exact top-level parser, visible UNKNOWN and fail-closed action gates.
regression_test: ui-system-state-truth contract tests + full web typecheck/CI.
prevention: ui-system-state-truth contract tests + full web typecheck/CI.
reusable_rule: No blocking UI action may rely on an inferred/default system state.
